paññapeyyaṁ,.g: thero kira attano katakiccabhāvaṁ disvā “ahaṁ imaṁ antimasarīraṁ dhāremi, tañca kho vātamukhe ṭhito padīpo viya aniccatāmukhe ṭhitaṁ, nacirasseva2 nibbāyanadhammaṁ, yāva na nibbāyati, tāva kinnu kho ahaṁ saṁghassa veyyāvaccaṁ kareyyan”ti cintento iti paṭisañcikkhati “tiroraṭṭhesu bahū kulaputtā Bhagavantaṁ adisvāva pabbajanti, te ‘Bhagavantaṁ passissāma ceva vandissāma cā’ti dūratopi āgacchanti, tatra yesaṁ senāsanaṁ nappahoti, te silāpaṭṭakepi seyyaṁ kappenti.
